description: The Chebyshev polynomial of the first kind T(n,x) at an integer x. T(0,x) is 1, T(1,x) is x, and T(2,3) is 17. n runs from 0 to 64 and x from -1000 to 1000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/chebyshev-t
